record.original_question: Alekseevskii's conjecture asserts that every homogeneous Einstein manifold with negative scalar curvature is diffeomorphic to Euclidean space. Equivalently, if a homogeneous Einstein manifold has the form G/K with K a maximal compact subgroup of G and has negative scalar curvature, must it be diffeomorphic to a Euclidean space?

evidence.quote: Question 3.9 (Alekssevsky’s Conjecture 7.57 in [A. L. Besse, Einstein manifolds. ...]. A homogeneous Einstein manifold with negative scalar curvature is conjectured to be diffeomorphic to a Euclidean space.

artifact.self_contained_problem: Alekseevskii's conjecture. Let (M, g) be a connected homogeneous Einstein Riemannian manifold, i.e. a connected Riemannian manifold whose isometry group acts transitively on M and whose Ricci tensor satisfies Ric(g) = c·g for some constant c. Assume that the scalar curvature of (M, g) is negative (equivalently, c < 0). Writing M = G/K with G a connected Lie group acting transitively by isometries and K a maximal compact subgroup, prove or disprove that M must be diffeomorphic to a Euclidean space ℝⁿ.
artifact.status_search_result: The Alekseevskii conjecture was proved by Christoph Böhm and Ramiro A. Lafuente in their work "Non-compact Einstein manifolds with symmetry" (arXiv:2107.04210), establishing that every homogeneous Einstein manifold with negative scalar curvature is diffeomorphic to a Euclidean space. Earlier partial results had verified the conjecture in low dimensions (e.g., Arroyo–Lafuente).

status_evidence.title: Non-compact Einstein manifolds with symmetry
status_evidence.snippet: Böhm and Lafuente prove a rigidity result implying the Alekseevskii conjecture: any homogeneous Einstein manifold with negative scalar curvature is diffeomorphic to Euclidean space.
status_evidence.claim: Full proof of the Alekseevskii conjecture.

status_evidence.title: The Alekseevskii conjecture in low dimensions
status_evidence.snippet: Arroyo–Lafuente verify the conjecture in low dimensions, providing earlier partial progress.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress prior to the full resolution.
